reason: §36 permits this evaluation if and only if the verdict is PHASE3_SEMANTIC_CLOSURE_PROVEN. It is not.
whatIsNowTrueThatWasNotBefore: AMB-1 is resolved in a written, versioned specification (V3.1) rather than left to reviewer discretion.
The evaluator implements that specification mechanically and generically, with the delta measured on all 1,115 units before a line was changed.
The 18 red semantic-accountability identities are resolved: one real production defect fixed generically, the rest proven stale and corrected to be stricter than before.
The one acknowledged OBVIOUS_FALSE_GAP is closed.
Blinded re-adjudication packets, a response schema, a frozen consensus rule and validating import tooling all exist and are ready for human reviewers.
whatRemains: Three independent reviewers must adjudicate the 47 frozen cases under V3.1.
Their responses must import cleanly, after which the four agreement metrics can be measured against the unchanged 90% thresholds.
Only then can Phase-3 closure be decided, and only if it passes may Phase-4E foundation readiness be assessed.
